messages.subject: Calculation of Factor Score Determinacy
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to compare the equivalence of two correlations in the same model (from the same group). However, perhaps due to the complexity of the model, it often gives me out-of-range estimates when I impose equality constraints on the model parameters. Therefore, I am thinking of extracting the factor scores in the model and directly compare the correlation of these factor scores with other variables.

I wonder if Lavaan library or R programme in general can calculate Factor Score Determinacy, as it is well-known that there may be multiple plausible solutions for factor scores and thus the extracted factor scores may be of poor quality.

Thank you,
Chester
